sheets.promptText:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: six NEW isolated casual mobile board-game icon illustrations, master sprite sheet, genuine transparent background.
Primary request: Draw six distinct polished playful 3D-cartoon game icons. All imagery newly drawn; no source pixels, no traced screenshots. Bright saturated rounded sculpted objects, bevelled edges, glossy highlights, strong readable silhouettes, soft internal shading, consistent camera and material style. Small icon legibility matters.
Composition: landscape 1536×1024 canvas, strictly THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows. Each subject centered in its own cell. Reading order left-to-right, top-to-bottom is exactly below. Six independent isolated artworks separated by VERY WIDE fully transparent gutters, at least 70px of transparent empty space from all neighboring artworks and all canvas edges. Each icon fits comfortably inside its 512×512 cell; do not connect neighboring subjects. No grid lines.
TOP LEFT: a compact little open shop display with an orange and white striped fabric canopy, curved awning, gold counter rim; below the canopy white game dice with dark dots and three colorful blue, purple and green card packs. Do not draw words.
TOP CENTER: a treasure sale bundle of a small shiny silver and yellow toy car, a few white dice with dark dots, bright green banknotes and blue/teal colorful card packs, arranged as one compact overlapping cluster. No signs, no labels, no SALE word.
TOP RIGHT: one dark walnut wooden treasure chest with softly bevelled purple iron braces and a large shiny golden old-fashioned key leaning diagonally across its front. Slight open lid with subtle gold glow. NO timer ribbon.
BOTTOM LEFT: a compact railroad reward bundle: two bright royal-blue collectible cards, a small blue toy locomotive and two white dice with dark dots grouped together. No words or railroad title.
BOTTOM CENTER: a pale icy blue translucent potion bottle, broad rounded body, short neck with dark blue stopper, two dark circular spots visible inside, a small vivid pink-purple orb at its lower right. Two chunky golden-yellow curved arrows wrap around the bottle, one pointing left and one right; one cohesive icon.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a small purple upright speaker box with two dark circular cones, a chunky yellow down arrow pointing at a compact green banknote in front; one cohesive icon.
Background: actual alpha transparency everywhere outside each object, with crisp anti-aliased silhouette edges. Preserve holes between objects as transparent.
Text: NONE, no letters, no numerals, no watermark, no brand marks.
Constraints: artwork ONLY. No UI, no frame, no surrounding badge, no circle medallion, no panel, no sticker border, no button, no banner, no title, no price, no count, no timer, no labels. No floor or ground plane, no drop shadow outside silhouettes, no long canvases attached to icons. Do not add other independent decorative objects or scatter particles. Exactly six icons.

prompt.text:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one NEW isolated cat-head icon for a polished casual mobile board game; square 1024x1024 master.
Primary request: Draw a single friendly silver-grey CARTOON CAT HEAD wearing a black rounded top hat with a rich purple hatband. This is clearly a CAT, an animal with two very visible pointed triangular feline ears sticking out to either side below the hat. NO human face.
Subject details: rounded silver-grey cat head, small dark triangular cat nose, short feline muzzle, plush white moustache-like WHISKER TUFTS on the two sides of its mouth, subtle whisker lines, warm kind readable eyes and gently smiling feline mouth. A charcoal-black eye-mask-shaped fur marking surrounds the eyes. Keep both pointed CAT EARS large and clearly visible so the species reads immediately at small size. Hat is a rounded soft black top hat with violet/purple band. Head only, no neck or body.
Style: playful polished soft 3D cartoon mobile-game illustration; rounded sculpted shapes, smooth gentle shading, subtle glossy highlights, crisp readable silhouette, appealing and warm. New original drawing from the specified concept, not a screenshot crop.
Composition: one large centered complete animal head and hat with all ears and whiskers intact. The head/hat occupy most of the square with only a small even transparent margin. Keep silhouette compact. No long narrow canvas.
Background: genuine transparent alpha outside the head, hat, ears and whiskers, including corner regions and any gaps. Crisp antialiased silhouette. No background color or scene.
Text: none.
Hard constraints: artwork ONLY. Absolutely no human, no person, no skin-tone face, no human nose, no human moustache, no human portrait. No UI, no rim, no badge, no medallion, no circle behind the head, no frame, no border, no ribbon, no banner, no count, no timer, no title, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no surrounding cast/drop shadow, no extra objects. The cat face must be unmistakable.

processing.cropBasis: alpha>=64 bounds +2px, all pixels and alpha inside crop preserved
processing.resize: Pillow LANCZOS proportional thumbnail max512, no stretch

assets.observed: Reference05 right-side fourth event shows silver/grey animal head with dark top hat/eye-mask area and white whisker moustache tufts. Source05 was actually viewed again before this generation.
assets.inferred: New unmistakable CAT head: two pointed feline ears, triangular cat nose, short feline muzzle, white whisker tufts, warm golden eyes, black rounded top hat with purple band. No human portrait pixels reused.

limitations: New original drawings matching observed concepts; no screenshot pixels, font/pixel/game-policy equivalence claimed.

Generated source alpha contains faint low-alpha haze; original RGBA and per-pixel alpha inside each crop are preserved. No hard transparency threshold, background removal or forced opacity was applied.
Crop bounds use alpha>=64 plus 2px only because nonzero alpha includes generation haze across the sheet. Alpha below64 within crop is kept unchanged.
No image registration or actual UI/browser check performed by asset subagent. One pirate-shield file is intended for four uses by parent.
